title: A brief with nothing of the business in it blocks before a build
steps: Run the readiness unit suite and the demo runner suite against this checkout with a throwaway TEST_DATABASE_URL. Every business in them is fictional.
expect: A Portland-like brief (profile bio, sharp labelled photos, empty reading) has check business-content with verdict block, and the brief's readiness is verdict block with next research-again.
A brief with an empty reading and no menu, post or logo fact also has business-content block.
A food brief whose only offering source is a published menu URL passes every readiness check, template-kinds included: verdict pass, next build.
A brief with offerings and no named team passes: people-with-portrait pass, business-content pass, verdict pass.
Offering items typed into a demo request (profile.menuItems) pass business-content for a trade with and without a menu; the bio alone still blocks.

In the runner, a measured brief with labelled photos and no business content is stored with business-content block; its demo action ends status failed, error BRIEF_NOT_READY; demoActionOf readiness.checks includes business-content; the create door is never asked and no wo_build row exists; wo_demo_usage is unchanged by the refusal.
evidence: Issue #554: Portland City Boxing revision 3 on dev (2026-11-10) had 0 offerings and 0 people, passed every readiness check and built a site with no classes, prices or coaches.
fence: briefReadinessOf business-content check (packages/wo/website-opportunities/domain/brief-readiness.mjs) and the BRIEF_NOT_READY refusal before a build

tests: Portland-like: a bio, sharp labelled photos and an empty reading still block
a reading with no offering, story or fact blocks
a business with offerings and no named team still passes
offering items typed into a demo request pass
a brief with good photos but no offering, story or fact is refused with its own reason
